R4D-bear-walk-0002.name: 1.4 km W of Long Mountain
R4D-bear-walk-0002.pressureWhy: 3.2 km on foot from the nearest parking (estimate).
R4D-bear-walk-0002.parkWhat: pull off on Four Mile Creek Rd (gravel road)

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2018 (8 years old), right here: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2018 (fire N51329), right here: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
W facing slope, 13 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Unnamed wetland 100 m S: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: bag 2; private land only, with landowner permission

plan: Drive: from Village of Nakusp, about 75 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 6 (E Hwy 6), Hwy 6, Hwy 6 (Union St), Four Mile Creek Rd.
Park: 49.90867, -117.21403, pull off on Four Mile Creek Rd (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 3.2 km S, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 401 m, about 103 min at 3 km/h.

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-17, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R4D-bear-walk-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 4-17: about 188 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.11 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: a long walk from parking. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).
